# Exact colour balance: light = k x source light per channel
# Pixel Perfect: no mask clipping in any fitted geometry
# k = 0.3172: every colour, white included, at 31.7% of its source light
# No pixel ever clips in the mask, so small details keep the colour of
# large areas; the price is brightness (raise the TV backlight)
